description: Use this when the user wants to cancel a capital call in one of their funds that nobody has paid. Starts the cancellation. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed cancellation, with what the investors are told, for the user to confirm. This call cancels nothing, and Capital Company never moves money.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_cancel_capital_call
title: Cancel capital calls
